tests.name: keeps markers in the store across a restart, edits and deletes them
tests.why: add, edit, delete through the host; markers survive reopening the store; title echoes 'survive a restart'

tests.name: accepts only a real date, a name, a known measure and a stated direction
tests.why: a marker is a date, a name and one known facet measure

tests.name: adds a marker in Insights, reads its before and after figures with session counts, edits it and deletes it
tests.why: owner adds, edits and deletes a marker on the Insights page, and it survives a reload

tests.name: compares equal windows on each side of the marker's day, counting sessions on each side
tests.why: before-and-after over equal windows with session counts; title quotes 'equal windows on each side'

tests.name: says too few sessions below the threshold on either side and states no verdict
tests.why: named threshold and the too-few flag; title quotes 'too few sessions'

tests.name: gives a verdict only when the owner stated the direction
tests.why: verdict words only with a stated direction; title echoes the MUST's direction rule

map.none: no test checks that no credits are spent or that nothing leaves the machine

tests.name: puts a session that starts at the marker's midnight after it and one a minute earlier before it, and leaves out the day past the window
tests.why: the 'marker near the window's edge' host case

tests.name: has no value for a measure with no data, and for a marker dated after today
tests.why: the 'measure with no data' host case, quoted in the title

tests.name: adds a marker in Insights, reads its before and after figures with session counts, edits it and deletes it
tests.why: the browser test of adding a marker and reading its figures, with expectCleanLayout; title echoes that wording

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::draws a marker's before and after with a labelled strip, neutral colours and a verdict word
findings.note: the verdict word's colour in one light theme falls below AA; the browser test at that round's head (not present at the mapped head) checks colours differ, not contrast, and a contrast check would be a CSS/browser test outside the Vitest gate, so a fail-on-base unit test would not expose it

notes: markers.test.ts and src/host/markers.ts are new, so on the base the unit file fails at import rather than on an assertion. Tests are top-level. Finding 4b's test exists only at its round head 4885254. Report found as the final message in markers-rereview.jsonl.
